title: Robotics & Autonomy Information Session
description: Meet the engineers building safer, more capable robots for logistics and healthcare. Bring your questions about internships, co-ops, and new-grad roles.

title: Clean Energy Careers at Blue Ridge
description: Learn how software, electrical, and mechanical engineers are helping modernize the Southeast energy grid. A casual networking reception follows the talk.

title: Designing Better Digital Health
description: A conversation with product designers and data scientists about building accessible tools for patients and clinicians. Open to all majors.

title: Space Systems Recruiting Night
description: Explore the teams behind resilient satellite systems, mission software, and flight operations. Students from computing, engineering, and physics are invited.

title: FinTech & Analytics Coffee Chat
description: Grab coffee with analysts and software engineers from Peachtree Financial. Get a behind-the-scenes look at early career pathways in financial technology.

title: Public Interest Technology Panel
description: Hear from technologists working at the intersection of data, policy, and community impact. The panel includes time for student Q&A.
